programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirmaet Carly Westin indvilliger i at tilberede et festmåltid for en veninde. Men parret bliver myrdet, mens hun er i køkkenet. Da politiefterforsker Jack bliver involveret, må han beskytte Carly. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: Da den urolige tvilling Dominique beder sin boglige søster Kimberly om at overtage hendes rolle som glamourøs parisisk model i en måned, tøver Kimberly. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa vågner op på hospitalet, kan hun ikke huske noget: Hun kan ikke huske, hvem hun er, at hendes mand ønsker at lade sig skilles. Da hendes mand tager hende med hjem, må Lisa lære alting forfra. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne mistænker, at hendes bror Alans død ikke var et uheld, og beslutter sig for at undersøge sagen. Hun begynder at arbejde for den magtfulde familie, der muligvis har haft en finger med i spillet. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En forældreløs piges (Mel Harris) søgen efter sin fortid begynder med et barndomsfoto af hende selv ved siden af en sjælden spilledåse og fører hende til en forførende skattejæger. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en smuk barnepige, giver nyt liv til Richard Keaton, en enkemand og videnskabsmand, og hans begavede, men fremmedgjorte søn Andy. Liz' liv er i fare, da hun kommer for tæt på sandheden. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: Da en dusørjæger, der er på sporet af en af hendes lejere, overbeviser Sara McAllister om at slå sig sammen med ham, begynder de et eventyr i den farlige verden af international spionage og kærlighed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterne Hallie og Donnalee arbejder på et stort byggeprojekt for en excentrisk milliardær, Adam Barr. Hallie, der har ledt efter sin drømmeprins, finder ham pludselig lige ved siden af. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiv Max er overbevist om, at Sandra død ikke var et uheld, men at hendes mand John myrdede hende. Da han møder Sandras tvillingesøster Nicky, får han hende til at hjælpe sig med en plan. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiv Max etterforsker Sandra Applewhites død og er overbevist om at hennes ektemann John Gilman drepte henne. Når han møter Sandras tvillingsøster Nicky, ber han henne om hjelp til å avsløre Gilman. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny ser aldri på sin kjedelige og lojale assistent Claire Bernard. Men når han oppdager at Claire er en uslipt diamant, bestemmer han seg for å forvandle henne til en fortryllende skjønnhet. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.sub-title: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programme.desc: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: 19-year-old Joan Wech left New Zealand for the bright lights of Sydney. But the first step on her overseas adventure would be her last. Was this a robbery gone wrong, a savage random attack or a revenge killing by a jealous ex-lover?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: A Mother's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Otautau toddler Amber-Lee, aged two and a half, vanished from Kingston at the southern tip of Lake Wakatipu on October 17, 1992.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Last Orders
programme.desc: In 1993, devoted father Kevin O'Loughlin came face to face with the dark side of sunny Nelson when he was brutally stabbed to death after a night out on the town.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Without Warning
programme.desc: This week’s episode of Sensing Murder promises greater co-operation between psychics and police, attempting to uncover the truth about the death of 18-year-old apprentice plumber Regan O’Donoghue, who was killed in a hit and run in 2007.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Vanishing Point
programme.desc: In 2003, 32-year-old mother of three Sara Neithe vanished from the Hauraki Plains. Neither Sara nor her car have been seen since. Police suspect that Sara has been murdered but without a crime scene, they have been unable to advance the case.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Lie of the Land
programme.desc: Sue Nicholson and Deb Webber investigate one of the most complex and intriguing cases ever featured - did Waikato man Jason Dark commit suicide or was he murdered, as his family believes?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: When The Trail Goes Cold
programme.desc: This episodes involves the disappearance of 62-year-old Kaye Stewart, a woman who went missing while on a short walk on June 13th, 2005.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Looking for Justice
programme.desc: This week, for the first time ever, the prime suspect in a murder enquiry has turned to Sensing Murder for help.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost for Words
programme.desc: Spirited teenager Jayne Furlong dreamed of becoming a child psychologist - instead, she ended up a prostitute. In 1993, 17 year old Jayne vanished from her patch on Auckland's Karangahape Road.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Psychics Revealed - Special
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the psychics on the show.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: Described as a brutal execution, 46-year-old grandmother Chattrice Maihi-Carroll was found naked, stabbed to death in her New Zealand home in 2008. There were multiple suspects and everything seemed resolved following the arrest of a neighbour.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Patient Killer
programme.desc: In 1976, thirteen-year-old schoolgirl Tracey Ann Patient was plucked off Auckland's Great North Road. The following morning, her body was found dumped 16 km away in the Waitakere Ranges, having been strangled with a pantyhose tourniquet.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: In 1957, nine-year-old Peter Boland was on holiday having the time of his life on a remote farm in New Zealand when he simply vanished without a trace. Peter’s older brother Gavin Boland, a self-confessed sceptic, turns to Sensing Murder’s psychics.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E08 A külső autópályán egy kétségbeesett férfi állítja meg Horatio autóját. Horatio megdöbben, amikor rátalál egy állapotos nőre, akit összeverve kidobtak az autójából. A 8. hónapban járó kismama állapota válságos, és a magzat élete is veszélyben van. A helyszínelők és a nyomozók megkettőzött erővel dolgoznak az ügyön, és egy meglehetősen szövevényes, sok szereplős bűncselekmény bontakozik ki előttük.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E09 Egy mezőgazdasági üzemben bomba robban, és egy fiatal bevándorló meghal. A helyszínelés során azonban nem találnak semmilyen robbanó anyagot. Úgy tűnik, hogy a gyártási körülményeket használta ki a gyilkos, és üzembalesetnek próbálta álcázni. A legfőbb gyanúsított a gyár tulajdonosa, akiről kiderül, hogy rendszeresen dobja fel illegális munkásait a hivatalnál.

programme.title: X-akták
programme.desc: S08E16 Mulder az áthelyezését kéri az X-aktákhoz, de Kersh elutasítja. Amikor megölik a Fehér Ház kertjében azt a férfit, aki biztos információval rendelkezik az idegenek inváziós terveiről, Mulder saját nyomozást indít, hogy további bizonyítékokat találjon a gyarmatosításra.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: S19E05 A kölni tartományi ügyészség egyik nagy figyelemmel kísért tárgyalására egy férfi bejuttat egy fegyvert azt bizonyítandó, hogy létezik egy anyag, mellyel a fémdetektor nem mutatja ki a fegyvereket. Épp a tárgyaláson jelenlévő tévéstábok közvetítését használja fel arra, hogy reklámot csináljon terrorista körökben az oldatnak, és eladja a legmagasabb áron. Mivel ez az anyag veszélyeztetné az egész világot, a készletért cserébe kénytelenek szabadon engedni. Ám kiderül, hogy a lopott képlettel már egy labor gyártja az utánpótlást.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: S18E13 Az autópálya-rendőrség két régi tagját mutatja be Krüger a kollégáknak, akik a 30 évvel korábban, a kezdetekkor az őrsön dolgoztak. Semirt felhívja fiatalkori nagy szerelme, Sina. Amikor találkoznak, Sina azt mondja, mindenkit meg akarnak ölni a régi társaságból. Mielőtt a részletekre térne, őt is meggyilkolják. Semir és Alex eleinte arra gyanakszanak, hogy egy régebbi autóbaleset áldozatainak fia a tettes.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők

Yeager, a nappali műszak ambíciózus helyszínelője magának szeretné az ügyet, ám végül együtt kell dolgoznia Morgannel. Hamarosan kiderül, hogy az áldozat gyakorlott kaszinófosztogató volt, és régi ügyei érték utol.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E07 Sarah azt gyanítja, hogy a helyszínelőknek örmény terroristákkal van dolguk, amikor egy vízelvezető csatornában talált holttestnél bombát fedeznek fel. Az egész csapatot rosszul érinti, hogy Greget megvádolják. A jelek szerint bizonyítékokat helyezett el egy régi ügyben, és szándékosan manipulálta a nyomozást.

programme.title: CSI: New York-i helyszínelők
programme.desc: S06E23 Flack letartóztat egy jól ismert sorozatgyilkost, az államügyész irodájába tartanak, de a gyilkos megtámadja az őt kísérő rendőrt, és megszökik. Mac és Stella követik a merénylő által hátrahagyott nyomokat, és a Guggenheim Múzeumban kötnek ki egy Andy Warhol festménynél. Eközben távol a zűrzavartól Lindsay és Danny a jól megérdemelt vakációjukat töltik, egészen addig, amíg valaki célpontba nem veszi őket.

programme.title: CSI: New York-i helyszínelők
programme.desc: S07E01 A helyszínelők legújabb alkalmazottja, Jo Danville bemutatkozása megdöbbentően hatásosra sikerül, amikor egy holttestre bukkan a 34. emeleten lévő bűnügyi laborban. A korábban FBI ügynökként dolgozó Jo mindent elkövet, hogy profizmusával lenyűgözze a labor legendás szakembereit, különösen Lindsay-t, aki nehezen birkózik meg a Jo dicsérete mögött rejlő szándékkal.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E10 Matthew Shaw-t aligátor támadja meg a saját medencéjében, miközben épp a barátnőjével beszél telefonon. Mire a rendőrök kiérnek, a férfi az életét veszti. A helyszínelők egyértelmű bizonyítékokat találnak arra, hogy az állat nem véletlenül tévedt a kertbe, valaki odacsalta. Mint kiderül, a férfi nagyon gazdag volt, és egy jóhírű társkereső irodán keresztül keresett magának partnert.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E11 Utcai lövöldözés során egy nő karambolozik, és ketten az életüket vesztik. A helyszínen megtalált két holttest között nem találnak egyértelmű kapcsolatot, feltételezhetően szeretők voltak, és egy féltékenységi leszámolás áll a háttérben. Hamarosan azonban kiderül, hogy a nő és a férfi nem is ismerték egymást, és egyikőjük véletlen áldozat.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E09 A csapat harmadszor megy ki ugyanahhoz a szállodához újabb és újabb holttest miatt. A hátborzongató gyilkossági ügyek körülményei annyira egyformák, hogy egyértelműen sorozatgyilkosra utalnak. Különös az esetben, hogy a három gyilkosság néhány hónapon belül ugyanabban a lepukkant szállodai szobában történt.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E11 A helyszínelők meghívást kapnak egy fantasztikus karácsonyi luxus partira. A gond az, hogy nem vendégként, hanem egy gyilkossági ügy miatt. Az esemény fő látványosságai, a valódi hó és az élő rénszarvasok korántsem könnyítik meg a helyszínelők munkáját.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E06 Grey elégedetten szemléli, ahogy Nolan, Chen és Harper egy ékszerrablásból származó aranyzsákmány után nyomoz az egyik gyanúsítottnál talált rejtélyes vers alapján. Eközben Bradfordot azzal bízzák meg, hogy ösztönözze a kapitányság legidősebb rendőrét, McGradyt a nyugdíjba vonulásra. Bradford azonban magával viszi a kincsvadászatra, amikor McGrady egy régi bizonyíték segítségével új nyomra bukkan.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők

programme.desc: S01E06 A fiatalon elhunyt Jason veszi fel a kapcsolatot Melindával. Amikor a fiú 17 évesen megtudta, hogy adoptálták, még azelőtt meghalt, hogy anyját megtalálta volna. Melinda segítségével végre megtalálja az édesanyját, Frant, ám a nő nem hajlandó tudomást venni fiáról és nem akar vele kapcsolatba lépni.

programme.title: Szellemekkel suttogó
programme.desc: S01E07 A kórházban járva Melinda összetalálkozik egy nyughatatlan nő szellemével. Az asszony arra kéri őt, hogy segítsen neki kideríteni, hogy mi okozhatta valójában a halálát egy sebészeti beavatkozás közben.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E07 Fred házának felrobbanása után Nolan és Bailey rájönnek, hogy a férfi halála mögött több van, mint amire gyanakodtak. Chen és Bradford nem tudnak beletörődni a kincsvadászat eredményébe, ezért visszavágót követelnek. A cél érdekében megkörnyékezik Grey rendőrtisztet, aki végül segít meghatározni az új fogadás feltételeit.

programme.title: Monk - Flúgos nyomozó
programme.desc: S06E02 Merényletet követnek el a híres rapper, Extra Large ellen, amikor bombát helyeznek el a limuzinja aljában, s a támadást csak a sofőrje éli túl. Az első gyanúsított a ,,Mészáros", aki a konkurens lemezkiadó cég rappere, s aki egy számot is írt Autóbomba címmel - Extra Large-nak címezve. A Mészáros azonban rövidesen felkeresi Monkot, s kéri, hogy derítsen fényt az igazságra.

programme.title: Monk - Flúgos nyomozó
programme.desc: S06E03 Egy 23 éves lány holttestére bukkannak a tengerparton. A nyomozóknak azonnal sikerül is megtalálni az első számú gyanúsítottat, ám a férfinak sziklaszilárd alibije van, ugyanis a gyilkosság ideje alatt egy rendőrségi fogdában ült. Monk azonban meg van győződve arról, hogy Peter Singer tette a dolgot, és elhatározza, hogy minden áron bebizonyítja az elméletét. Adrian Monk lelkivilágát eközben alaposan megviseli, hogy éppen a nudista partszakaszon kénytelenek nyomozni.

programme.title: Magnum

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E12 Több utas is felfedezi a reptéren, hogy útközben ismeretlen módon kirabolták a kézipoggyászukat. Hamar nyomára bukkannak a lehetséges tettesnek, bár a módszerére még nincs magyarázat. Ám nem sokkal azután, hogy a fő gyanúsított elhagyja a repülőteret, hamarosan holtan találják.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E13 Egy oknyomozó újságíró látszólag autóbalesetben vesztette életét. De a helyszínelők rájönnek, hogy még életben van, és egy szigorúan titkos katonai projekt mögé bújva próbálja meg feltárni az igazságot. Ám hamarosan kiderül, hogy még a legbiztonságosabb védelemnek is van gyenge pontja.

programme.title: CSI: New York-i helyszínelők
programme.desc: S07E04 El Puñót (Ököl), az egyik legbefolyásosabb harlemi banda vezetőjét meggyilkolják. A bandák közti rendkívül kényes egyensúly megőrzése érdekében is azonnal lépni kell. Mac és csapata a tettes után nyomozva megkeresi Luther Devarrót, Puño bizalmas barátját is.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E14 Blair Hawkinst, a végzős egyetemistát késő éjjel megkövezik a sportpályán. A nyomozás során sok csúnya ügyre derül fény, az áldozat módszeresen járatta le és alázta meg diáktársait nagyközönség előtt. Hamar meg kell állapítaniuk, hogy az összes sértett képes lett volna elkövetni a tettet. A nyomok arra utalnak, hogy legalább ketten felelősek a lány haláláért.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E15 Két lányt elrabolnak, ám az egyiknek sikerül megszöknie fogvatartójától. A rendőrség késve érkezik a helyszínre, a másik lányt már holtan találják. A megvizsgált áldozatot láthatóan megkínozták mielőtt végeztek volna vele. Natalie egy véletlen folytán rájön, hogy a tettes nincs egyedül, a lányokat valószínűleg egy szerelmes pár rabolta el.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E14 Dr. Robbins Mexikóba utazik, hogy boncolást végezzen az egyik barátja lányán. Eközben Vegasban a helyszínelőket egy férfi és egy nő holttestéhez rendelik ki, akiket lelőttek és később betonba temették el őket. A kettősgyilkosságnak rengeteg gyanúsítottja van, csakhogy a motiváció minden esetben gyenge lábakon áll.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E16 Las Vegas utcáit egy újabb sorozatgyilkos tartja rettegésben. A helyszínelők hamarosan rájönnek, hogy egy olyan gyilkos után kutatnak, aki szenvedélyesen rajong a sakkért. Ugyanis áldozatai és a bűncselekményhez megválasztott helyszínek egy sakktábla lépéseire hasonlítanak. Greg kénytelen egy régi mentorához fordulni, hogy a játszmában segítsen megtalálni a leendő áldozatokat.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E08 Nolan és Lopez megpróbálja észhez téríteni a szuverén állampolgár Marvin Reynoldsot, de a férfi rájuk lő és megszökik. Hamarosan Harper és Thorsen fegyvereket és egy kiáltványt talál Reynolds lakókocsijában. Bradford nyíltan támogatja Nolant a szakszervezeti képviselői posztra Smitty-vel szemben.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Dunkles Wasser - Als Danny bei einem Unfall stirbt, nutzen Clara und der Doktor die telepathische Schnittstelle der TARDIS, um ihm ins Jenseits zu folgen. Die Spur führt über das 3W-Institut mitten ins "gelobte Land". Die Skelette der Toten werden in einer dunklen Flüssigkeit aufbewahrt. Auch Cyberman-Technologie ist bei der Konservierung im Spiel. Offenbar besteht das vermeintliche Paradies aus einer ewigen Sphäre, die in Wahrheit ein Matrix-Datenprozessor ist. Der Doktor lernt zudem Missy, die Chefin an der Himmelspforte, kennen. Sie gehört selbst zur Gattung der Timelords und ist die weibliche Inkarnation des Masters.

programme.title: Ohne Limit
programme.desc: Eine Designerdroge bringt das lausige Leben von Eddie Morra (Bradley Cooper) auf Vordermann. Dank "NZT" kann der heruntergekommene Schriftsteller sämtliche Kapazitäten seines Gehirns nutzen und wird zum Genie. Sein rasanter Aufstieg an der Börse führt ihn bis in höchste politische Kreise. Auch dem erfolgreichen, jedoch auch teilweise am Rande der Legalität agierendem Geschäftsmann Carl van Loon (Robert De Niro) bleibt Eddies Höhenflug nicht vorenthalten. Aber seine Blitzkarriere bringt auch Neider mit sich und sein Vorrat neigt sich dem Ende. - Starbesetzter Business-Thriller von Regisseur Neil Burger.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Das Enzym - Das legendäre Atlantis existiert tatsächlich! Ein internationales Team aus Wissenschaftlern und Militärs auf der Erde hat eine sensationelle Entdeckung zu verbuchen: Im ewigen Eis der Antarktis findet es ein Tor zu einer neuen Welt. Durch das neue Stargate, ein Sternentor, gelangt ein Forschertrupp zur Pegasus Galaxie, wo sich die legendäre Stadt Atlantis befinden soll. Die gefährliche Mission führt das Atlantis-Team weit hinein ins Universum - weiter, als jemals zuvor ein Mensch gewesen ist. - Spin-off der Fernsehserie Stargate SG-1, welches ebenso wie das Original von Showrunner Brad Wright erdachte wurde.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown - Mythen auf der Spur
programme.desc: Die Legende der Schlangenkönige - Von den Pyramiden der Mayas über die Schiffsreisen der Wikinger bis zu den legendären Steinkreisen von Stonehenge: Josh Gates ist in "Expedition Unknown" historischen Mythen auf der Spur - packenden Geschichtsrätseln, die bis heute Fragen aufwerfen. Was hat es mit den Ruinen von El Mirador auf sich? Sind unerschrockene Nordmänner aus Skandinavien im Mittelalter über den Atlantik bis nach Amerika gesegelt - lange bevor Christoph Kolumbus die Neue Welt entdeckte? Und welchem Zweck dienten die Megalith-Monumente nahe der englischen Stadt Salisbury? Diese Doku-Serie liefert spannende Fakten und zeigt auf, wo die Expertenmeinungen auseinandergehen.

programme.title: Action Heroes
programme.desc: Josh Brolin - Josh Brolins Schauspielkarriere begann bereits 1985 - mit Steven Spielbergs Abenteuerklassiker "Die Goonies". Später folgten Rollen in weiteren weltbekannten Filmen, wie "No Country for Old Men" der Coen-Brüder oder "Dune".

programme.title: Action Directors
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese - Martin Scorcese gehört zu den ganz Großen im Filmgeschäft. Der Oscarpreisträger mischt seit über 60 Jahren in Hollywood mit und hat das Publikum mit epischen Werken wie "Taxi Driver", "GoodFellas" oder "Gangs of New York" beglückt.

programme.title: Action Heroes
programme.desc: Harrison Ford - Porträt-Reihe mit Vorstellungen zeitgenössischer Stars des Actionkinos.

programme.title: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen
programme.desc: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen - Heute: Was tun, wenn dein Durchbruch auf sich warten lässt? Mit ihrer direkten, humorvollen und zugleich tiefgründigen Art vermittelt die US¿amerikanische Autorin und Bibellehrerin Joyce Meyer alltagsnahe Impulse, die Glauben und Leben miteinander verbinden. In ihren praxisorientierten Botschaften zeigt sie, wie biblische Prinzipien helfen können, Herausforderungen zu meistern, innere Freiheit zu finden und eine neue Haltung zum eigenen Alltag zu entwickeln. Millionen Menschen schätzen ihre authentische, klare Sprache und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich auf den Punkt zu bringen. Die Sendung bietet inspirierende Denkanstöße, die Mut machen und zu persönlicher Veränderung einladen.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Die Saat des Verrats - Das Stargate, aufgebaut in einem geheimen US-Militärkomplex, ist das Relikt einer uralten Zivilisation. Über dieses Tor gelangt man sekundenschnell zu unzähligen anderen Planeten, auf denen sich weitere Stargates befinden. Das Team von Colonel Jack O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) hat die Aufgabe, über diese besonderen Alltransfers Kontakte zu anderen Zivilisationen zu knüpfen und die Erde gegen Angriffe von außen zu schützen, aber auch die Entstehung des Lebens und Lebensformen auf fremden Planeten zu erforschen. - Die Serie basiert auf Roland Emmerichs gleichnamigem Kinofilm (1994) und setzt dessen Handlung direkt fort.

programme.title: Meteor Storm
programme.desc: San Francisco wird von einem tödlichen kosmischen Inferno heimgesucht. Was als harmloser Meteoritenschauer beginnt, wächst innerhalb kürzester Zeit zu einem gewaltigen Bombardement aus dem Orbit heran. Während Wissenschaftlerin Dr. Michelle Young (Kari Matchett) gemeinsam mit ihrem Mann Tom (Michael Trucco) fieberhaft nach einer Lösung sucht, wie die Apokalypse aus dem All in letzter Sekunde abgewendet werden kann, geht die Zerstörung an der kalifornischen Pazifikküste weiter. - Katastrophenfilm von Tibor Takács.

programme.title: Beyond Skyline
programme.desc: Die Erde wird von einer gewaltigen Alien-Invasion heimgesucht! Die Außerirdischen sind technologisch hochentwickelt und mit riesigen Raumschiffen gekommen, um die Menschheit zu versklaven. Als Los Angeles in Schutt und Asche gebombt wird, geraten der Polizist Mark Corley (Frank Grillo), dessen Sohn Trent (Jonny Weston) und Audrey (Bojana Novakovic) an Bord des feindlichen Flaggschiffs. Obwohl die Aliens dort reihenweise Menschen in bizarre biomechanische Hybrid-Kreaturen verwandeln, müssen die entführten Homo sapiens einen Weg finden, den extraterrestrischen Terror zu stoppen. - Bei der Fortsetzung des Sciencefiction-Films "Skyline" (2010) gibt Liam O'Donnell sein Regiedebüt.

programme.title: High Heat
programme.desc: Das Ehepaar Ana (Olga Kurylenko) und Ray (Don Johnson) hat so seine Geheimnisse. Als die beiden ihr gemeinsames Restaurant eröffnen, steht plötzlich die Mafia auf der Matte, um von Ray immense Schulden einzutreiben. Allerdings haben sich die Mafiosi definitiv den falschen Laden ausgesucht. Denn wie sich herausstellt, verfügt Ana über beachtliche Kampftechniken mit dem Küchenmesser. Auch der Umgang mit der Kalaschnikow ist für die Ex-KGB-Agentin kein Problem! Ana fackelt nicht lange und zeigt den Gangstern, wer im Restaurant der Chef ist. - Für seine Rolle in der 80er-Jahre-Kultserie "Miami Vice" wurde Don Johnson mit dem Golden Globe ausgezeichnet.

programme.title: Ocean's Rising
programme.desc: Sonneneruptionen werden das gesamte Leben auf der Erde beenden: Alle Technik fällt aus, Eiskappen schmelzen, Erdplatten verschieben sich und Wassermassen überfluten die Küsten. Das sind die Vorhersagen von Josh (Jason Tobias). Der Forscher hat entdeckt, dass das Magnetfeld der Erde versiegt und warnt vor einer alles vernichtenden Sintflut. Aber niemand hört ihm zu. - Hauptdarsteller Jason Tobias hat eine Vorliebe für B-Movies. Er war auch bereits in "Star Wars" und "Fast & Furious"-Kopien zu sehen.

Sind unerschrockene Nordmänner aus Skandinavien im Mittelalter über den Atlantik bis nach Amerika gesegelt - lange bevor Christoph Kolumbus die Neue Welt entdeckte? programme.title: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen
programme.desc: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen - Heute: Beziehungstipp: Wie du die Herzen anderer eroberst Mit ihrer direkten, humorvollen und zugleich tiefgründigen Art vermittelt die US¿amerikanische Autorin und Bibellehrerin Joyce Meyer alltagsnahe Impulse, die Glauben und Leben miteinander verbinden. In ihren praxisorientierten Botschaften zeigt sie, wie biblische Prinzipien helfen können, Herausforderungen zu meistern, innere Freiheit zu finden und eine neue Haltung zum eigenen Alltag zu entwickeln. Millionen Menschen schätzen ihre authentische, klare Sprache und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich auf den Punkt zu bringen. Die Sendung bietet inspirierende Denkanstöße, die Mut machen und zu persönlicher Veränderung einladen.

programme.title: Air America
programme.desc: Die Piloten Gene (Mel Gibson) und Billy (Robert Downey jr.) fliegen für "Air America" während des Vietnamkrieges eine der heißesten Flugstrecken zwischen Laos und Vietnam. Offiziell transportieren sie Frachtaufträge für Laos, inoffiziell bedienen sie für ihren Vorgesetzten den Heroinhandel. Im Gegenzug unterstützt ihn Laos im Kampf gegen Vietnam. Doch Washington bekommt Wind von der Sache... - Die Fluggesellschaft Air America existierte von 1949 bis 1976 und war vor allem während dem Vietnamkrieg für die CIA von großer Bedeutung. Der US-amerikanische Geheimdienst bestreitet allerdings, von dem florierenden Heroinschmuggel gewusst zu haben.

programme.title: The Marine
programme.desc: Der Soldat John Triton (John Cena) wird aus dem United States Marine Corps entlassen, da er im Irak Befehle missachtet hat. Zurück in den USA fällt es Triton schwer, wieder ein normales Leben als Zivilist zu führen. Doch die Jobprobleme geraten in den Hintergrund, als seine Ehefrau Kate (Kelly Carlson) von einer Bande Diamanten-Räuber gekidnappt wird! Triton nutzt seine militärischen Fähigkeiten, um einen brutalen Befreiungsfeldzug gegen Gangsterboss Rome (Robert Patrick) und dessen Männer zu starten. - Das Drehbuch zum Film stammt von Alan B. McElroy und Michelle Gallagher. Die Hauptrolle im Action-Streifen übernimmt der Profi-Wrestler und World Champion John Cena.

programme.title: Beyond Skyline
programme.desc: Die Erde wird von einer gewaltigen Alien-Invasion heimgesucht! Die Außerirdischen sind technologisch hochentwickelt und mit riesigen Raumschiffen gekommen, um die Menschheit zu versklaven. Als Los Angeles in Schutt und Asche gebombt wird, geraten der Polizist Mark Corley (Frank Grillo), dessen Sohn Trent (Jonny Weston) und Audrey (Bojana Novakovic) an Bord des feindlichen Flaggschiffs. Obwohl die Aliens dort reihenweise Menschen in bizarre biomechanische Hybrid-Kreaturen verwandeln, müssen die entführten Homo sapiens einen Weg finden, den extraterrestrischen Terror zu stoppen. - Bei der Fortsetzung des Sciencefiction-Films "Skyline" (2010) gibt Liam O'Donnell sein Regiedebüt.

Que ce soient les merveilles de la culture, les découvertes scientifiques fascinantes ou les enjeux de notre monde, chaque épisode se veut à la fois instructif et divertissant.

programme.title: Clap, le magazine culturel
programme.desc: Chaque semaine, un magazine consacré à l'actualité du cinéma, des séries américaines et de la fiction française.

programme.title: Top Info
programme.desc: Top Info est un JT quotidien pensé pour les jeunes adultes. Chaque édition s'ouvrira sur trois temps forts de l'actualité, avant de se poursuivre avec un sujet de fond, incarné par de jeunes journalistes, pour approfondir une thématique. Une fois par semaine, cette séquence mettra l'accent sur la lutte contre la désinformation et l'éducation aux médias.

programme.title: Super Nanny - Saison 7
programme.desc: Débordés par leurs enfants, certains parents ne savent plus quoi faire pour retrouver leur autorité et l'harmonie au sein de leur foyer. Au bord de la crise, ils font appel à Super Nanny qui leur vient en aide en s'intégrant à leur famille pendant une semaine. Cette éducatrice de choc aide les parents et leurs enfants à construire de nouvelles bases.

programme.title: Super Nanny - Saison 10
programme.desc: Débordés par leurs enfants, des parents ne savent plus quoi faire pour rétablir autorité et harmonie au sein de leur foyer. Souvent, ils sont épuisés par la situation et ont baissé les bras. Heureusement, Super Nanny est là pour aider ces couples ou ces parents solo à reconstruire des liens plus équilibrés avec leur tribu. Elle permet aussi à chacun de retrouver sa juste place dans la famille.

programme.title: Hogie the Globehopper
programme.desc: Hogie the Globehopper is a fun tv show that will inspire a curiosity and fascination about the world and its people. Hogie and his friends Lorna, Bernie and Floaty travel the world, making lots of friends along the way.

programme.title: Mya Go
programme.desc: Mya Go is a preschool animated show about a young girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. Set in the bustling town of Everyday, Mya Go lives here with the Go family and lives nearby her closest friends.

programme.title: Bernard
programme.desc: Follow Bernard as he makes a mess of things!

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.title: Nutri Ventures
programme.desc: Protecting Healthy Foods At All Costs!

programme.title: Chefclub Kids
programme.desc: With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger is a 3D animated musical series designed by the BarryTiger brand for children aged 1-8. With delightful and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the everyday adventures of BarryTiger and his friends. The show features a wide range of themes, diverse scenes, and captivating content. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a true audiovisual feast for children.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.title: Counting With Paula
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Horaci the Inuit

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

மஸ்கரி

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

बकलोल

బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.

பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

சாஸ் பஹு ஸ்பெஷல்

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.
